title: 23-Year-Old Acts Like An Entitled Maniac After Police Arrest Her
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 22nd, 2023. Officers were called to the plane concerning a highly intoxicated woman who threatened to “kick the flight attendants ass” & she was also belligerent and apparently threw her luggage at the attendants. When officers spoke to her, she kept trying to convince Police that the flight attendants treated her bad and was being mean to her, after awhile Police deemed that she was too intoxicated to be on her own and was placed under arrest. After she was arrested, the 23-year-old started to become extremely belligerent and started to act in an unusual manner, she didn’t know why she was being placed under arrest. This is the body-cam footage of the events. 

#news #police #arrest
